key.name: panel-width
key.description: Width of the Control Center in pixels.

key.name: show-backdrop
key.description: Draw one glass panel behind all tiles instead of floating tiles.

key.name: tile-order
key.description: Order in which tiles fill the panel (all tiles, including hidden ones).

key.name: glass-style
key.description: auto follows the dark/light toggle; dark and light force a variant.

key.name: accent-color
key.description: Hex colour (#rrggbb) of active toggles. Empty means automatic (white on dark glass, graphite on light glass).

key.name: blur-strength
key.description: Strength of the live backdrop blur behind the glass surfaces. 0 disables the blur.
